clips.subtitleText: Level 1: She stood right under the funnel and waited for gravity 💀
Level 2: Tried to saber the champagne and shattered the whole bottle 😭
Level 3: The entire warehouse tower leaned over and turned into an avalanche 💀
Level 4: Jumped through a literal ring of fire on skis 🔥⛷️
Level 5: Poured water on a grease fire and turned the kitchen into an inferno 🔥
